operation_rule: Collect observed links before saving; scan at most six scroll states, prioritize links revealed by scrolling, deduplicate and exclude known bodies, then save at most three same-origin area details. No fixed listing URL or area ID.
assumptions: The observed area detail URL shape remains /chintai/souba/{prefecture}/{area}/.
limitations: Only links present in the initial listing and up to six scroll results are considered; pages requiring a different navigation control are not handled.
